== experiments with gcc ==
*[[gcc interface|an interface to the gcc code generators]]
*[[treedef]] - a ruleset that generates stub procedures from [http://savannah.gnu.org/cgi-bin/viewcvs/gcc/gcc/gcc/tree.def tree.def]
*[tree.d] - the resulting file of stub procedures that can be directly used in experiments
*[gccmain.d] - a main procedure for experimenting with the stub procedures
*[[d2gccbe]] - part of experimental backend for the [[documentation#the D language|d-to-d translator]]
*[[gcc interface#results|results]] - the results of a small experiment
